title: CrysLDM: Latent Diffusion Model for Crystal Material Generation
abstract: arXiv:2611.29675v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating new crystal materials with desirable chemical properties has long been a challenging task. Existing diffusion models operate in feature space, requiring complex diffusion architectures to model the joint distribution of atom types, coordinates, and lattice structures. This complexity increases the number of diffusion steps, leading to higher training and sampling costs. In this work, we aim to generate novel crystal materials within a time- and resource-constrained setup, where existing models are not well-suited. To address this, we propose CrysLDM, a novel latent diffusion model for 3D crystal materials, which integrates a variational autoencoder and a diffusion model. The VAE encoder maps 3D crystal structures into a latent space, where the diffusion model operates. translated_title: CrysLDM：用于晶体材料生成的潜在扩散模型
translated_abstract: 生成具有理想化学性质的新晶体材料长期以来一直是一项具有挑战性的任务。现有的扩散模型在特征空间中运行，需要复杂的扩散架构来建模原子类型、坐标和晶格结构的联合分布。这种复杂性增加了扩散步骤的数量，导致更高的训练和采样成本。在本工作中，我们旨在在时间和资源受限的条件下生成新型晶体材料，而现有模型并不适合这种场景。为解决这一问题，我们提出了CrysLDM，这是一种新颖的面向三维晶体材料的潜在扩散模型，它将变分自编码器（VAE）与扩散模型相结合。VAE编码器将三维晶体结构映射到潜在空间中，扩散模型则在该潜在空间中运行。由于CrysLDM利用了平滑的、更低维度的潜在空间，它简化了生成过程，并加速了训练和推理。通过广泛的（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: CrysLDM通过将变分自编码器与扩散模型相结合，在平滑的低维潜在空间中生成三维晶体材料，从而简化了生成过程并显著加速了训练与推理。
en_tdlr: CrysLDM integrates a variational autoencoder with a diffusion model to generate 3D crystal materials in a smooth, lower-dimensional latent space, simplifying the generative process and accelerating both training and inference.
